description: This PHP class 'DetailedLeaveRequest' handles leave request related calculations within a human resource management system. It manages leaves, leave periods, balances, workflows, and related actions for a specific leave request.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequest
classes.description: Handles leave request calculations, leaves management, leave periods, balances, workflows, and permitted actions for a specific leave request in the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DetailedLeaveRequest with a specific LeaveRequest object.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Sets a new LeaveRequest object and resets internal cached data.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches and sets all leaves related to the current leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns sorted array of Leave objects related to the request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the collection of leaves and their dates, validating non-empty input.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Adds a single Leave to the internal collection, maintaining sorted order.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Computes and returns total number of days for the leave.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed information about leave dates and durations.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdown
methods.description: Returns breakdown of leave statuses and their total lengths, excluding weekends and holidays.

methods.name: getLeaveBalances
methods.description: Returns leave balances for each leave period considering the employee's entitlement.

methods.name: getLeavePeriods
methods.description: Calculates and returns leave periods based on leave dates and entitlement strategy.

methods.name: hasMultipleStatus
methods.description: Checks if the leave request has multiple statuses.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns permissible actions like 'APPROVE' or 'REJECT' based on current status.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflows for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a specific action is permitted for the current leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Returns the workflow object corresponding to a specific action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns the current leave request status. Throws exception if multiple statuses exist.
